SECRET STRATEGIST
Secret Strategist Giveaway: Win a Maap Wall Lamp From Flos
By Lauren Ro, a senior writer at the Strategist covering home and parenting. 
OCT. 8, 2026
Photo: Flos

We write about lamps a lot on the Secret Strategist Substack and found Flos’ recently launched design by Erwan Bouroullec to be quite compelling. It’s made from a paperlike polyethylene sheet that you attach to the light fixture with a magnetic button. The shade is meant to be shaped by hand — crumpled, smoothed, or otherwise manipulated — however you wish. The resulting effect is a sculpture-as-light that emits a diffused glow, our favorite kind. (It reminds me of the wall Akari that designer Pali Xisto Cornelsen has in his living room.)

It’s available in three sizes — with one, two, or three magnetic buttons — and can be used alone or installed together. We’ve partnered with Flos to to give one Secret Strategist reader the single-button Maap W1 Wall Lamp, which measures about five by five feet before shaping.

Enter the sweepstakes by signing up for the Secret Strategist newsletter here (or reenter your email address if you’re already a subscriber) for a chance to win. Entries for the sweepstakes are open now until November 7. Participants must subscribe to the Secret Strategist to be eligible to win.

NO PURCHASE NECESSARY. A PURCHASE DOES NOT IMPROVE YOUR CHANCES OF WINNING. Sweepstakes begins on 10/8/2026 at 3:00 AM EDT and ends on 11/7/2026 at 3:00 AM EDT. Open to legal residents of the (50) contiguous United States and D.C. who are aged 18 or older. (1) Prize valued at $925 will be awarded. Odds of winning depend upon the number of entries received. Void in AK and HI and where prohibited. Subject to complete Official Rules. Sponsor: Vox Media Group, LLC, 1701 Rhode Island Avenue NW, Floor 12, Washington, D.C. 20036.
